name: tollgate
description: Pre-commit checks that just work: runs your lint, typecheck, Biome and Prettier, blocks secrets, debug code, conflict markers and large files, and enforces commit message rules — from VS Code or the terminal.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Tollgate runs commands from the repository (package.json scripts, custom checks), so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Tollgate needs a local git repository and file system.

commands.title: Auto-fix Whitespace & EOF in Staged Files

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder that is a git repository to start checking your commits.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

tollgate.enabled.description: Master switch. Set false to pause all checks.

tollgate.extends.description: Preset to start from; everything else overrides it.

tollgate.failOn.description: Lowest severity that blocks the commit.

tollgate.stopOnFirstFailure.description: Stop remaining checks after the first blocking failure.

tollgate.concurrency.description: How many command checks run in parallel.

tollgate.exclude.description: Globs ignored by every file-based check. Replaces the default list.

tollgate.packageManager.description: Used for package.json scripts. `auto` detects from lockfiles / "packageManager".

tollgate.autoFix.description: In the hook, auto-fix trailing whitespace / EOF newlines (when those checks are enabled) and re-stage fully-staged files.

tollgate.checks.description: Built-in checks. Each one can be enabled/disabled and tuned. Unset values come from the preset.

npmScripts.description: Run package.json scripts (lint, typecheck, format:check…) when they exist.

enabled.description: Turn this check on or off.

exclude.description: Globs (relative to repo root) this check ignores, on top of the global `exclude`.

scripts.description: Script names to run, in order, if present in package.json.

scope.description: `root`: repo-root package.json only. `affected`: nearest package.json of each staged file (monorepos).

stage.description: Which git hook runs the scripts.

passStagedFiles.description: Append staged files as arguments (npm run lint -- a.ts b.ts).

fileExtensions.description: Staged files that make scripts relevant.

alwaysRun.description: Run even if no staged file matches fileExtensions.

enabled.description: `auto` runs only when a lint-staged config exists.

dotnet.description: C# / .NET: dotnet format, dotnet build, CSharpier and dotnet test. `auto` turns on when a .sln/.slnx/.csproj/.vbproj/.fsproj exists.

enabled.description: `auto` runs when the repo contains a .NET solution or project.

target.description: Solution or project to use, relative to the repo root (e.g. "src/Acme.sln"). Auto-detected when empty: the root solution, else the projects owning the staged files.

fileExtensions.description: Staged files that make the .NET checks relevant.

exclude.description: Globs to ignore, on top of the global `exclude`.

isolateOutput.description: Build and test into a private folder (needs the .NET 8+ SDK) so an app running via `dotnet run`/`dotnet watch` does not lock the binaries and fail the checks.

mode.description: `auto` = `all`, or `style` when CSharpier handles formatting. `whitespace` is the fastest (no MSBuild).

applyFixes.description: Format fully-staged files and re-stage them instead of failing.

build.description: `dotnet build` — catches compile errors before they reach the repo.

test.description: `dotnet test` (off by default; on at pre-push in the strict preset).

enabled.description: `auto` runs when CSharpier is in .config/dotnet-tools.json or a .csharpierrc file exists.

applyFixes.description: Format fully-staged files and re-stage them.

enabled.description: `auto` runs when a Prettier config (.prettierrc*, prettier.config.*, package.json "prettier") or the prettier dependency exists, and no package.json script already runs prettier.

applyFixes.description: Format fully-staged files with --write and re-stage them (partially-staged files are only checked).

exclude.description: Globs Prettier should skip (in addition to .prettierignore).

enabled.description: `auto` runs when biome.json(c) or @biomejs/biome is present and no package.json script already runs biome.

applyFixes.description: Run with --write and re-stage fully-staged files.

secrets.description: Detect API keys, tokens, private keys and hard-coded credentials in added lines.

enabled.description: Turn this check on or off.

exclude.description: Globs (relative to repo root) this check ignores, on top of the global `exclude`.

extraPatterns.description: Additional secret patterns. If a pattern has a capture group, group 1 is treated as the secret value (placeholders such as "changeme" or "${VAR}" are then ignored).

allowlist.description: Regexes; matching lines are ignored. Inline: add `tollgate-ignore` or `pragma: allowlist secret` to a line.

exclude.description: Globs (relative to repo root) this check ignores, on top of the global `exclude`.

debugStatements.description: Find console.log, debugger, .only tests, pdb, binding.pry…

forbiddenFiles.description: Block files that should never be committed (.env, keys…).

patterns.description: Glob patterns; prefix with ! to allow (e.g. "!.env.example").

protectedBranches.description: Warn/block when committing directly to protected branches.

pattern.description: Extra RegExp the whole message must match (multiline).

maxSubjectLength.description: Maximum subject-line length (default 500; the strict preset uses 100). 0 = no limit.

requireTicket.description: Require a ticket reference such as ABC-123.

tollgate.checks.markdownDescription: Built-in checks. Edit in settings.json, e.g. `"tollgate.checks": { "todoComments": { "enabled": true } }`. Values in `.tollgaterc.json` take precedence.

tollgate.custom.description: Your own checks: any shell command. Placeholders: {files} (matching staged files), {root}, {branch}, {msgFile}, {stagedCount}.

id.description: Stable id (used by SKIP=). Defaults to a slug of the name.

glob.description: Only run when staged files match; {files} is filtered to these.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to repo root.

alwaysRun.description: Run even when no staged file matches.

restage.description: Re-stage files changed by this command (formatters with --write/--fix).

tollgate.autoInstallHooks.description: Install git hooks automatically when a repository is opened.

tollgate.notifyOn.description: When to show a notification after a git hook runs.

tollgate.showDiagnostics.description: Show findings in the Problems panel.

tollgate.showDisabledChecks.description: List disabled checks in the Tollgate view so they can be enabled with one click.

enumDescriptions: .tollgaterc.json if it exists, otherwise workspace settings
tollgate.configTarget.description: Where changes made from the UI (toggle, add check, preset) are saved.
